legend: There are n%%ZSMJ0%% employees at Odoo numbered from 1%%ZSMJ1%% to n%%ZSMJ2%%, each employee has exactly 1%%ZSMJ3%% manager, except for the head with the number 1%%ZSMJ4%% who has no manager. So they form a rooted tree.

We call employee a%%ZSMJ5%% a subordinate of another employee b%%ZSMJ6%% if either b%%ZSMJ7%% is the manager of a%%ZSMJ8%%, or the manager of a%%ZSMJ9%% is a subordinate of employee b%%ZSMJ10%%. In particular, subordinates of the head are all other employees of the company.
You will be given very sensitive information: An integer array A%%ZSMJ11%% of size n%%ZSMJ12%% where Ai%%ZSMJ13%% is the salary of the ith%%ZSMJ14%% employee at Odoo (1≤i≤n)%%ZSMJ15%%.

For the following q%%ZSMJ16%% years, at the beginning of the year, one lucky employee u%%ZSMJ17%% is picked alongside an integer value denoted as x%%ZSMJ18%%. For that employee, their salary will be multiplied by x%%ZSMJ19%%. Also, for all subordinates of u%%ZSMJ20%% their salary will be multiplied by x%%ZSMJ21%% as well.

An employee is happy at some year if their salary was divisible by k%%ZSMJ22%% in that year. You will be given the value of k%%ZSMJ23%% and your goal is to print n%%ZSMJ24%% integers where the ith%%ZSMJ25%% integer (1≤i≤n)%%ZSMJ26%% is the first year at which employee number i%%ZSMJ27%% was happy.
If one employee was happy initially print 0%%ZSMJ28%% and if they were never happy print −1%%ZSMJ29%%.
input: The first line contains 3%%ZSMJ30%% integers n%%ZSMJ31%%, k%%ZSMJ32%%, q%%ZSMJ33%%, (1≤n,q≤2∗105)%%ZSMJ34%% (1≤k≤109)%%ZSMJ35%%
The second line contains n%%ZSMJ36%% integers A1,A2,..,An%%ZSMJ37%% (1≤Ai≤109)%%ZSMJ38%%
The third line contains n−1%%ZSMJ39%% integers P2,P3,..,Pn%%ZSMJ40%% where Pi%%ZSMJ41%% is the manager of employee number i%%ZSMJ42%%. (1≤Pi≤n)%%ZSMJ43%%
Then q%%ZSMJ44%% lines follow, The ith%%ZSMJ45%% line contains two integers ui%%ZSMJ46%% and xi%%ZSMJ47%% (1≤ui≤n)(1≤xi≤109)%%ZSMJ48%%
output: Print n%%ZSMJ49%% integers, the answer to the problem
